Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 4, Verse 2

“Thus received in succession, the royal sages knew it. But over a long stretch of time, that yoga was lost here, scorcher of foes.”

Note who kept it — rajarshis, kings who were also sages. The teaching was carried by people who governed and fought, which is precisely Arjuna's own situation.
